note: The styles of Edit canvas and Sketch to image (plan B, docs/plan-edit-sketch-stile.md). Each style keeps only its look; tools/build_style_looks.py puts it into the frame sentence of each tab (models.EDIT_FRAME, models.SKETCH_FRAME) and writes the modes edit and sketch of pccomfy/assets/styles.json. tabs: where the style is offered. fixed: a tested sentence kept word for word (a name in pccomfy/models.py). Tested in the style pilot 10.11.2026 (Flux 3 + Qwen, docs/tests/stil-pilot-ergebnis.md): the styles with tested true; the others were chosen by the user on 10.11.2026, untested.
